lines.C: You've been reading Precursor logs. They disagree with each other. Isn't it wonderful?
lines.B: The Keepers went down. The Ascendants went up. The Sleepers went in. Nobody went home.
lines.A: I think the Signal is older than the Choir. I think it's younger too. I need a drink.
lines.S: Bring me anything from the Seed. A pebble. A sentence.
lines.SOVEREIGN: When you come back, tell me which one of them was right. Or don't. I like not knowing.
